name: Madagascar Cisticola
rangeDescription: Grassland of madagascar and aldabra (southwestern seychelles)
description: Tiny brown bird with a long tail and bill. Note streaked back and pale underparts.

name: Dusky Thrush
rangeDescription: Northern siberia to kamchatka; winters to japan, southern china, and myanmar
description: This heavily marked thrush is easily identified when seen well. Females average duller than males, but both sexes have a dark cheek on an overall white face, brown upperparts (strongly rufous-tinted in males), bright rufous wings, and dark underparts densely marked with white chevrons.

name: Black-chinned Weaver
rangeDescription: Southeastern gabon (lekoni) to central angola and adjacent congo republic
description: A black-backed weaver with a yellow rump and different-looking sexes: the female has a black hood and throat, and the male has a yellow-orange forehead, crown, nape, and neck, with black restricted to the face and throat. An uncommon resident in open bushy savanna with isolated patches of forest between 500 and 1500 meters of elevation, often in disjunct populations.

name: Turati's Boubou
rangeDescription: Rainforest of guinea-bissau, western guinea, and western sierra leone
description: Chunky black-and-white bushshrike. The upperparts are cleanly black and the underparts are white with a pinkish wash, especially on the breast.

name: Brown Hornbill
rangeDescription: Assam, myanmar, and southwestern china to thailand and indochina
description: As the name suggests, a brown bird with a horn (casque) on its bill. Males are more brightly marked, with a white face and light orange-brown underparts.

name: Southern Grosbeak-Canary
rangeDescription: Savanna of southern kenya and northeastern tanzania
description: A large seedeater with a very thick pinkish bill. Brownish-olive above and yellow below with streaking along the sides.
imageCreditName: Keith Valentine I Rockjumper Birding Tours

name: Silvery Wood-Pigeon
rangeDescription: Islands off western sumatra (simeulue, babi, banyak, and siberut); formerly also the mentawai, riau, and lingga archipelagos surrounding sumatra and the anambas, natunas, and karimata islands west of borneo
description: Beautiful grayish-white pigeon with black wing- and tail-tips. Rare, little-known, and extremely localized; now found only on islands off western Sumatra (though may occasionally wander onto the main island), where it forages in lowland and hill forest.

name: Camiguin Bulbul
rangeDescription: Camiguin sur (southern philippines)
description: A fairly large bulbul of forest and forest edge on Camiguin, where it is unmistakable. Dark olive-brown with a pale bill.

name: Capped Heron
rangeDescription: Lowlands of eastern panama to the guianas, brazil, and northern paraguay
description: This gorgeous medium-sized heron is uncommon but widespread in lowlands of South America, barely extending into eastern Panama. Not likely to be mistaken: combination of silvery back, buffy neck and belly, black cap, and blue lores (sometimes radiant turquoise!) help distinguish this species from other herons.

name: Scissor-tailed Kite
rangeDescription: Savanna of sub-saharan africa
description: A slim, pale raptor with a very long scissor-like tail. Gray above and white below, typically with small black marks on the shoulders.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Rufous-breasted Warbling Finch
rangeDescription: West slope of andes of peru (la libertad to ica)
description: Rare and endangered bird found at high elevations in the western Andes of northern and central Peru. Note the black mask and the reddish-orange eyebrows, throat, and breast.

name: White-lined Honeyeater
rangeDescription: Northern australia (sandstones of western arnhem land, northern territory)
description: Rather plain medium-sized honeyeater found in sandstone escarpment and gorge country of western Arnhem Land, including the sandstone areas of Kakadu National Park and Katherine Gorge. Upperparts uniformly gray-green, underparts pale with diffuse gray streaks on chest.

name: Writhe-billed Hornbill
rangeDescription: Central philippines (panay, guimaras, and negros)
description: A large rare bird of lowland and foothill forest on Panay and Negros, although almost extinct on the latter. Mostly black with a cream-colored tail with black terminal band, an orange casque, and a wrinkled lower bill.

name: White-browed Tit-Spinetail
rangeDescription: Andes of southern peru (apurímac and cusco)
description: Small, active bird found locally in the southern Peruvian Andes. Brownish gray with a red cap, a white-streaked face, breast, and back, and a white eyebrow.

name: Puna Tapaculo
rangeDescription: Andes of southeastern peru (vilcanota mountains) to central bolivia (cochabamba)
description: Tiny, plump gray-and-brown bird that looks almost tailless. Males are ashy gray with warm reddish brown on their back half; females are similar, with the warm reddish brown extending farther up the back to the crown.

name: Yellow-winged Tanager
rangeDescription: Eastern mexico to eastern nicaragua
description: Fairly common in tropical lowlands and foothills, favoring forest edge and woodland, as well as semi-open areas such as towns and gardens with larger trees. Mainly feeds at mid-upper levels in trees, eating fruit, and perches readily on phone wires.

name: Biak Gerygone
rangeDescription: Biak (cenderawasih bay, off northwestern new guinea)
description: A small bird of wooded habitats on Biak Island. Olive-brown back, gray head, pale yellow belly and broken white eye-ring.

name: Pied Stilt
rangeDescription: Indonesia to australia and new zealand; winters to philippines
description: Large black-and-white shorebird with long straight, needle-like bill, and very long pink legs. Note black hind-neck.

name: Dark Pewee
rangeDescription: Montane forest of costa rica and far western panama (chiriquí)
description: The only all-dark crested flycatcher in range. Entirely sooty-gray, only slightly paler on throat and belly.

name: Brown-breasted Kingfisher
rangeDescription: Philippines
description: A fairly large kingfisher of lowland and foothill open country and forest edge. Chocolate brown on the underparts and hood, down to the upper back.
